newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI Australia says position stronger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI Australia says position stronger.

text.p: Chemicals group ICI Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it expected a large capital expenditure programme to begin to pay off in coming years, but domestic economic activity and prices would dictate profits.

In reporting an annual net profit of A$197.1 million after abnormals for the year ended September 30, ICI Australia said it had invested heavily over the past five years to improve its competitiveness and in some cases boost production capacity.
"The completion of a number of these projects has placed the company in a stronger competitive position which will deliver benefits in the coming years," the company said.

"However, the company's result will remain dependent on the level of activity of the Australian economy, particularly the housing and construction sector and on the strength of international plastics and chemical prices."
